method: Chrome normal search UI, only CPD selected; visible XML cell and result links read after asynchronous completion
scope: Two targeted entry families, not a random sample or full-edition audit; no training admission

observations.comparison: Agrees with English PDF20 headword/sense correction and PDF22 deletion direction. Website splits the printed optional suffix into two forms. Persian PDF86/printed90 independently has hūkar(ag), gloss خوکره; the Persian species equivalence is not independently certified.

observations.note: Textbox contained xūkar* after search, but displayed result link and table still belonged to hūkar*. This is not evidence of absence. No legacy entry deletion claim is made for the website.

observations.comparison: Full XML preserves noun versus derived-adjective senses found on English PDF116/printed94 and Persian PDF160/printed164. Simplified sense loses the noun meaning.
